title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools for agents
summary: Hold: the spending-control automation only lists spending policies; it cannot set a spending limit. The roadmap facts and cited admin paths are supported, but the tool count needs qualification and the general statement about REST write operations needs its supporting citation.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies is the automation counterpart for the row governing spending limits and consumption.
claims.quote: List spendingPolicies | GET /copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies | Get a list of spending policies. ... Update spendingPolicy | PATCH /copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} | Update a spending policy.
claims.fix: Replace the call with 'PATCH /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id}' and its docs URL with https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/cost-management/spendingpolicy-update. Add to the row note: 'The request body sets periodLimit for the policy spending limit or perUserLimit for the per-user limit.' Make the same replacement in the rendered table. The current GET only lists policies and cannot configure a spending limit.
